subject: Request: Combined credit + extension & discount approval for Salem Ridge POC
messages:
From: Lisa Morgan <lisa@salemridge.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ethan Voss <evoss@salemridge.com>, procurement@salemridge.com
Date: Fri, 1 Dec 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Salem Ridge POC - ask for extra credits + 2-week extension

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the guided run last week — the model throughput looks promising. Two asks from our side before we can commit to a pilot: a) can Redwood extend the POC window by 2 weeks (current end 12/14 -> 12/28) to give our data team time to stress test, and b) would you be able to provide a $10k credit top-up to cover the extra token usage we expect during a heavy integration pass?

We understand this is an exception request, but a short extension + credits would let us get a production-quality signal. If you need any more details on our success criteria I can share the test plan.

Best,
Lisa
Director of Data & AI
Salem Ridge

--

Subject: Re: Salem Ridge POC - ask for extra credits + 2-week extension

Hi Lisa — appreciate the quick note and the test plan attachment. We're supportive of the extension and believe the incremental credit makes sense for the level of integration work you described.

I looped in Marissa (AM) and Ben (VP Sales) since this will need an exception approval for combined credit + discounting flexibility. Naomi from Finance is here for any billing/commit coordination.

Next step from our side: I will put together an approval write-up for Ben and add a suggested fallback policy (auto-limit to avoid runaway usage). Can you confirm the main success criteria and expected peak TPS during the extended window? That will help us size the credit precisely.

Thanks,
Soojin Lee

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 4 Dec 2028 08:47:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Salem Ridge POC - ask for extra credits + 2-week extension

Ben — forwarding Salem Ridge's ask. Quick summary and my recommendation below.

Quoted: see below from Lisa.

My take: Salem Ridge is mid-market, high expansion potential (healthcare integrations). They're asking for $10k credits + 2-week extension. They are on a 90-day POC; we have healthy engagement (2 integrations, active SRE contact). If we approve credit+extension we should: 1) require a signed addendum to the POC SOW that lists success metrics and a short commitment window upon completion (30 days to decide), and 2) set a token cap alert + automatic throttle at 120% of current baseline to protect capacity.

Recommended approval band: up to $12k credits and up to 3-week extension if we get the signed addendum. Suggest a blended 10% onboarding discount on the first 3 months if they convert.

Happy to jump on a 15-min call if helpful.

-Marissa
Sr. Manager, Sales Operations

--
Attachment: SalemRidge_SOW_v1.pdf (PDF, 96KB)
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 4 Dec 2028 10:13:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Salem Ridge POC - ask for extra credits + 2-week extension

Thanks for the summary. Approve in principle but want guardrails documented and legal looped before we finalize. Concrete asks from me:

- Cap credits to $11,000 and tie release to signed SOW addendum and a short rollout commitment clause (30-day decision).
- Include an explicit SLA exception: allow short extension but preserve latency SLOs; if their tests cause service instability we revert and notify.
- Naomi, please confirm accounting treatment for the promo (credit vs. discount), we prefer a promotional credit applied to hosted usage rather than an invoice write-off.

If those conditions are acceptable I'll sign off and we can have Soojin send the addendum template to Lisa.

-Ben
VP, Sales — Redwood Inference
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 5 Dec 2028 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Salem Ridge - accounting for promo credits

Ben/Marissa — accounting note: we can record this as a promotional credit on the hosted usage ledger. Please ensure the SOW addendum references the credit ceiling ($11,000) and that credits expire 90 days after issuance if unused. We'll need a final billing code and HubSpot flag for revenue ops to reconcile.

Also recommend adding one compliance check checkbox: given they will run production-ish data during the POC, confirm they will not upload PHI-sensitive records to the sandbox environment (Lisa, please confirm).

-Naomi
Dir, Revenue Accounting
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Lisa Morgan <lisa@salemridge.com>, Ethan Voss <evoss@salemridge.com>, procurement@salemridge.com

Date: Wed, 6 Dec 2028 14:23:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Salem Ridge POC - ask for extra credits + 2-week extension

Hi Lisa — great news: Ben has approved an exception with the following terms (please reply to confirm):

1) Credit: promotional hosted-usage credit up to $11,000 (applied to your POC usage). Credits issued upon signed SOW addendum. Credits expire 90 days after issuance.
2) Extension: we will extend the POC by up to 3 weeks (new end date 2029-01-11) contingent on the signed addendum.
3) Guardrails: a) automatic token throttle at 120% baseline to avoid runaway billing; b) an explicit rollback clause if test traffic causes instability; c) a simple compliance pledge that no PHI will be uploaded to sandbox without a signed data processing addendum.
4) Conversion sweetener: 10% onboarding discount available on the first 3 months if Salem Ridge signs a paid contract within 30 days of POC completion.

Please confirm acceptance and attach the signed addendum. I'll send the addendum template and the DocuSign link in a separate message. Looking forward to getting you over the finish line.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
